commits.messageBody:
PR #720 (palette-ux-enhancement stale branch) merged with a base that
predated PR #719, silently reverting the entire task-orchestrator
Claude-surface integration that had landed via #719.  This commit
restores exactly the clobbered content from the
`task-orchestrator-claude-surface` branch without touching the
legitimate Palette UX work or any post-clobber changes on main.

Restored (24 files):
- .claude/commands/dx/*.md  — 17 /dx: slash commands
    backlinks, block, blocked, cancel, complete, complete-tree,
    context, depends, next, note, notes, preview, reopen, resume,
    search, start, tree
- .taskorchestrator/config.yaml  — canonical orchestrator schema (26 KB)
- docs/03-reference/dx-command-authoring.md
- docs/03-reference/orchestrator-note-filling-protocol.md
- docs/90-adr/adr-task-orchestrator-claude-surface-integration.md
- scripts/external-references/README.md
- scripts/external-references/task-orchestrator-current-stdio.sh.snapshot-*

Nothing else changed. Doctrine files (.claude/CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md,
superclaude-workflows.md, etc.) were partially reverted by the same
clobber but have since been updated on main via subsequent PRs (#722+);
restoring them here would conflict with those edits and is out of scope.

Fixes: palette clobber from commit d8e0268d3 (PR #720, 2026-05-28).
Related: PR #719 (original landing), PR #724 (blocked on this restore).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.messageBody:
root-hygiene CI failure:
  config/repo_hygiene/root_hygiene_policy.json — add .taskorchestrator
  to allowed_root_dirs so the pre-commit hook accepts the restored
  config.yaml (the directory was previously allowlisted on older main
  but never added to the hygiene policy).

Review comments (Copilot + Codex):
  docs/03-reference/orchestrator-note-filling-protocol.md
    — Remove unsupported actor field from advance_item call (schema
      only accepts {itemId, trigger, summary?}); actor attribution
      section rewritten to encode attribution in summary until
      structured actor support is exposed.
  .taskorchestrator/config.yaml
    — Fix ADR status comment: adr-task-orchestrator-as-workflow-
      authority is still "proposed", not "accepted".
  .claude/commands/dx/complete.md
    — Remove query_notes from allowed-tools (unused; only get_context
      and advance_item are called from this command).
  .claude/commands/dx/notes.md
    — Correct note-search description: /dx:search finds work-items,
      not note text; note full-text search is not available.
  .claude/commands/dx/complete-tree.md
    — complete_tree uses itemId not rootId; removed unsupported
      includeRoot parameter.
  .claude/commands/dx/blocked.md
    — get_blocked_items only accepts parentId + includeBlockerDetails;
      replaced unsupported includeItemDetails/includeAncestors.
  docs/90-adr/adr-task-orchestrator-claude-surface-integration.md
    — Fix .claude/CLAUDE.md link case → .claude/claude.md (broken on
      case-sensitive filesystems).
  CHANGELOG.md
    — Add [Unreleased] entry for this restore (required by repo policy).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.messageBody:
…dx commands

Per MCP_TOOL_MANIFEST.json the actual advance_item schema takes flat
{itemId, trigger, summary?} — NOT a transitions array. Updated:
  docs/03-reference/dx-command-authoring.md — transitions array → flat params
  .claude/commands/dx/start.md  } all write wrappers
  .claude/commands/dx/complete.md } that called advance_item
  .claude/commands/dx/block.md   } with the wrong
  .claude/commands/dx/resume.md  } transitions:[{...}] shape
  .claude/commands/dx/cancel.md  }
  .claude/commands/dx/reopen.md — added unsupported-trigger notice;
    reopen is not in the deployed enum (start/complete/block/hold/resume/cancel)
  .claude/commands/dx/next.md — removed unsupported limit+includeAncestors
    from get_next_item call (schema: parentId/role/priority/tags only)
  .claude/commands/dx/context.md — replace get_context(since=) with
    get_context(mode=session) (since is not a valid param)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
